actions.description: Show v2 unit file and database schema
actions.command:
cat /etc/systemd/system/rollout-v2.service; echo '---'; python3 -c "
import sqlite3
c = sqlite3.connect('/var/lib/rollout/records.sqlite3')
print(c.execute('select sql from sqlite_master').fetchall())
print(c.execute('select count(*) from records').fetchall() if True else '')
"
